text:
Maria: Heads up — customer reported SCIM provisioning creating users with emails like "j.smith…@acme.com" (literal ellipsis, U+2026). Provisioner fails to finish. Can someone triage?
Devin: literal U+2026 vs three dots "..."? Important for comparisons.
Maria: literal. I pulled logs, snippet below.
Maria: ```
2026-04-10T15:12:09Z scim-provisioner ERROR user_create failed id=9823 external_id="j.smith…@acme.com" err="kms:Decrypt failed: envelope header mismatch"
2026-04-10T15:12:09Z scim-provisioner DEBUG envelope_header="eyJhbGciIjoi…" (base64)
```
Elaine: Which IdP? Okta/GSuite/AAD?
Maria: Okta customer tenant (prod-sandbox). Only happens when AD forwarded attribute >64 chars — Okta appears to truncate with an ellipsis.
Ashok: If we bind the KMS encryption context to external_id (as we do for service-account wrappers) a different byte sequence will change the AAD and KMS unwrap will fail.
Samir: Confirming: we include external_id as encryption context on wrap? I thought we used tenant_id + key_version only.
Ashok: We include external_id for per-entity encryption to reduce blast radius for cached tokens. See: context = {tenant: "acme", external_id: external_id}. That will break if IdP normalizes/escapes characters.
Maria: Audit logs show decrypt attempts with context external_id="j.smith...@acme.com" (three dots) vs stored envelope expecting U+2026. So two different strings.
Devin: Ok. Two separate problems: 1) IdP mutating attributes (ellipsis), 2) our use of raw external_id in KMS context without normalization.
Elaine: For immediate mitigation, can we relax decryption context matching? i.e., try fallback path that ignores external_id when unwrap fails (with audit/event).
Ashok: We can add a fallback: try unwrap with provided context, if fails, try unwrap without external_id. Must log and alert each fallback occurrence. Risk: weaker envelope correlation, but acceptable short-term.
Maria: Agreed. I'll open an incident and mark it P2/P3 (affects only new users from some IdPs).
incident-bot: Created INC-2026-0423: "scim: idp ellipsis causing kms unwrap failures" assigned to eng-security.
Samir: Longer term: normalize external_id at ingest: unicode normalize (NFKC) and map U+2026 to three dots OR canonicalize by percent-encoding non-ascii. We should also store a canonical_external_id used only for crypto context.
Devin: +1 for canonical_external_id. That avoids changing customer-visible identifier. Backfill plan: for existing affected envelopes, rewrap with canonical key context. We need to ensure RBAC mappings are unchanged.
Elaine: RBAC note: role assignments derive from SCIM groups keyed to user id (internal_id), not external_id — backfill rewrap should not flip roles. But double-check any downstream systems that use external_id as key.
Maria: Query to find affected rows:
Maria: ```sql
SELECT id, external_id FROM users WHERE external_id LIKE '%…%';
```
Ashok: Good. Also check for U+2026 in audit logs:
Ashok: ```bash
# find decrypt failures where external_id contained non-ascii
jq -r '.events[] | select(.err|test("Decrypt")) | .context.external_id' /var/log/provisioner/*.json | grep -nP "\xE2\x80\xA6"
```
Samir: For the schema change: add column canonical_external_id (nullable). On user create/update set canonical_external_id = normalize(external_id). Then use canonical_external_id as KMS context.
Devin: Migration runbooks:
Devin: 1) Add column and backfill canonical_external_id for all users (idempotent).
Devin: 2) Deploy change to provisioner to use canonical_external_id for wrap/unwrap.
Devin: 3) Run rewrap job for envelopes where unwrap previously failed (log-driven).
Elaine: Make sure audit trail records rewrap operator and old vs new envelope metadata. Compliance wants immutability trace.
Maria: I'll draft runbook. Assignments: Maria -> incident + runbook; Ashok -> implement fallback & normalization prototype; Devin -> DB migration & rewrap job; Samir -> coordinate KMS key policy review (ensure fallback still auditable).
Maria: Also ping Okta SE: ask if they have a setting to disable ellipsis truncation or to send raw bytes. @devops-accounts can you loop in Okta contact?
devops-accounts: Pinged Okta SE; they requested sample SAML/SCIM payloads. Sent logs.
Devin: Quick mitigation patch: provisioner will try unwrap(context) then unwrap({tenant, external_id.replace('…','...')}) then unwrap({tenant}) and emit metric scim.kms.unwrap_fallback=1 with tag reason=(ellipsis|partial_context). Rollout to canary first.
Ashok: One more detail: ensure we don't leak the canonicalization step in audit to external IdP (store only hashes if needed). Security/compliance OK?
Elaine: Compliance: we need to retain original external_id in logs for customer debugging, but redact in public exports. Keep canonicalization deterministic.
Maria: Thanks team — I'll post the runbook link in this thread once drafted and update INC-2026-0423.
Samir: If someone is free can you prototype a small script to rewrap 10 failing envelopes for QA? I can help with key access.
Devin: I'll do the 10-sample rewrap tomorrow morning (canary).
Maria: Closing note: tracking metrics to watch: scim.provision.failures.kms_decrypt, scim.kms.unwrap_fallback, idp.attribute.ellipsis.count.
Ashok: Also add alert if fallback rate > 1% over 5m.
Maria: thx :thumbsup:
